task: NHANES measured CBC proxy evaluation for five-year all-cause mortality

age_cap80.rule: min(RIDAGEYR, 80); analysis-domain eligibility requires original RIDAGEYR >=40. Values of 80 represent age 80 or older, not exact age 80.
age_cap80.rationale: Harmonizes early top-coding at 85 with later top-coding at 80.

income_poverty_ratio.rule: Keep finite values in [0,5]; zero is valid. Values outside this codebook range and missing values are left missing.

bmi.rule: Use the released BMI value when finite and positive; otherwise missing. No outcome-driven trimming.

waist_cm.rule: Use the released waist circumference when finite and positive; otherwise missing.

sbp_mmhg.rule: Arithmetic mean of all available finite positive readings among attempts 1 through 4. Missing if none. The same prespecified aggregation is used in every cycle.

dbp_mmhg.rule: Arithmetic mean of all available finite positive readings among attempts 1 through 4. Zero readings are excluded from this prespecified analytic average. Missing if none.

pulse_bpm.rule: Use the released finite positive BPXPLS value. It is already the 60-second pulse rate; do not multiply by two again.

sex.rule: Use the recorded NHANES category; missing or other codes remain missing.

race.rule: Keep the same five recorded categories in every cycle. Missing or other codes remain missing.

education.rule: Use adult DMDEDUC2, not the earlier three-category DMDEDUC. Codes 7 (refused), 9 (unknown), and blanks are missing.

smoking.rule: SMQ020=2 -> never, even when SMQ040 is structurally skipped; SMQ020=1 and SMQ040 in {1,2} -> current; SMQ020=1 and SMQ040=3 -> former; all other combinations -> missing.
smoking.note: The standard never category refers to not having smoked at least 100 cigarettes in the lifetime.

general_health.rule: Use the household questionnaire HUQ010 consistently; do not mix with MEC HSD010. Codes 7,9 and blanks are missing.

diabetes.rule: Keep borderline as its own category. Codes 7,9 and blanks are missing. Use the baseline questionnaire, never the death-certificate DIABETES flag in the mortality file.

cvd.rule: Any source variable=1 -> yes; all five=2 -> no; otherwise missing. Unknown answers are not recoded as absence of disease.

hypertension.rule: Self-reported prior professional diagnosis. Codes 7,9 and blanks are missing. Do not use the mortality-file HYPERTEN flag.

cancer.rule: Self-reported history of any cancer or malignancy. Codes 7,9 and blanks are missing.

rdw_pct.rule: Released true laboratory measurement, finite and positive. Required to be observed for analysis-domain eligibility. Do not impute a reference measurement or trim on outcome association.

hemoglobin_g_dl.rule: Released true laboratory measurement, finite and positive. Required to be observed for analysis-domain eligibility. Do not impute a reference measurement or trim on outcome association.

outcome.name: y_5y
outcome.prerequisites: ELIGSTAT=1 for analysis eligibility; MORTSTAT in {0,1}; finite PERMTH_EXM>=0.
outcome.control: PERMTH_EXM>60, or MORTSTAT=0 and PERMTH_EXM>=60, with valid mortality status and follow-up
outcome.unknown: Alive with less than 60 months of follow-up, invalid or missing status, or invalid/missing follow-up. Such records are outside the eligible analysis domain.
outcome.boundary_note: A death at month 0 or month 60 is retained as an event. Do not require PERMTH_EXM>=60 for all subjects.
outcome.public_use_limitation: NCHS perturbs follow-up time or cause of death for selected records while leaving vital status unperturbed. Five-year boundary labels can be affected; there is no attempted recovery or assumed per-record perturbation bound.

cohort_and_design.design_frame: All ages with RIDSTATR=2, finite positive WTMEC2YR and observed positive integer SDMVSTRA and SDMVPSU. Retain domain-ineligible rows to preserve the survey design frame.
cohort_and_design.analysis_domain: Rows in the design frame with RIDAGEYR>=40, ELIGSTAT=1, both real CBC measurements finite and positive, and valid, determinable five-year outcome.
cohort_and_design.weight: WTMEC2YR/2 in both pooled four-year periods. Training code may normalize weights inside its own fitting subset.
cohort_and_design.is_eligible: Boolean indicator of the prespecified analysis domain; false rows receive no model predictions.
cohort_and_design.taylor_domain_note: For later survey-domain Taylor variance estimation, merge eligible predictions back to the full design frame and explicitly set out-of-domain linearized contributions to zero. Do not multiply NaN predictions by zero or manufacture model predictions for ineligible rows.
cohort_and_design.design_degrees_of_freedom: Compute the number of unique PSUs containing eligible observations minus the number of their unique strata in the evaluation subset. Do not hard-code two PSUs per stratum or a fixed degrees of freedom.
cohort_and_design.temporal_scope: Retrospective later-cycle cohort evaluation, not a simulation of deployment before all training outcomes occurred.

preprocessing_scope.current_script: Only deterministic file linkage, field-specific recoding, cohort assembly and univariate counts/missingness. No model fits, associations, predictor imputation, target transformations or effect estimates.
preprocessing_scope.later_modeling: Only the 16 listed X columns are allowed predictors for g(X) and the X-only baseline. Fit imputation, scaling and categorical encoders on the relevant training split. Z truth must remain measured. Use the same X and missingness information consistently across compared routes.
preprocessing_scope.categorical_missing: Empty CSV cells represent missing values. Treat every listed categorical column as categorical even when two categories are present.
